//: Pinned Freenet binaries bundled into PUF-AM. Committed; the binaries themselves are not (see vendor/README.md).
//pin: One binary per platform since Phase 2 of Plans/FREENET_NETWORK_PACK.md (2026-09-11): PUT is the app's own WebSocket client, so `fdev` is no longer fetched or bundled. Every platform still MUST come from the same release tag — the node's accepted contract API version is release-sensitive. Bumping this file means re-running scripts/verify-pack-contract.mjs and `npm run mist:smoke:native` against the new node.
//source: Checksums transcribed from the release's own SHA256SUMS.txt; extracted-binary checksums computed from those archives (the release also lists the bare `freenet.exe` digest, which matched).

toolVersions.//: Reported by `freenet --version` on the extracted linux-x64 binary: `Freenet version: 0.2.135 (ea1ff5f169bc)`, build timestamp 2026-09-10T17:17:44Z.

license.//: freenet-core is AGPL-3.0. LICENSE.md states that distributing the unmodified binary alongside an app that talks to it over WebSocket does not make that app a derivative work — which is exactly what PUF-AM does. The text still ships next to the binaries.

packContract.//: Bundled pack-contract WASM. codeHashB58 must equal PACK_CONTRACT_CODE_HASH_B58 in units/mist-freenet/src/freenet02-pack.ts — a drift there silently changes every published mist URI.

slotContract.//: Join-slot contract, built from units/mist-freenet/contracts/slot-contract (ours, not upstream). codeHashB58 must equal SLOT_CONTRACT_CODE_HASH_B58 in units/mist-freenet/src/freenet02-slot.ts.
slotContract.//address: Every slot address is BLAKE3(codeHash || slotId || farmVerifyingKey). Re-pinning this hash moves every slot, so a ticket minted before the bump stops resolving over Freenet. Bump it only with a plan for the tickets in the field.
slotContract.//rebuild: npm run mist:build:slot — needs cargo + wasm32-unknown-unknown only; the script wraps the raw WASM in the 40-byte contract package header itself. Reproducible on one machine with one toolchain; a different rustc will land a different hash, which is why the artifact is committed rather than built during packaging.

builtWith.//: Recorded so a hash mismatch can be told apart from a toolchain drift. `fdev` is the historical packager of the pinned copy (it wrote the package header); rebuilds no longer use it.

linux-x64.//: musl builds: statically linked, so they run on Fedora without matching a host glibc. Status is `pending-live-check` until `npm run mist:smoke:native` has passed against this exact binary; it becomes `verified` then.

win-x64.//: Checksums pinned from the same release. Not yet launched on a Windows host — that lands with the NSIS build in Phase 3.
